records.title: And every fair from fair sometime declines,By chance, or nature’…
records.body: And every fair from fair sometime declines,By chance, or nature’s changing course, untrimmed; But thy eternal summer shall not fade, Nor lose possession of that fair thou ow’st 를 해석해줘
records.comment: "Lv. 2. 좀 어려운데, 한글로 번역해서 읽어볼래!" 챕터 수록
